name: Perilous Seat

attributes.attribute: recognizes heroism and holds the Grail finder
sat once in failure and once after finding the Grail
cracked when unworthy and was later mended

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Perilous Seat, also called the Siege Perilous, is an Arthurian site. It works like the Celtic Inauguration Stones. The Seat recognized true heroism. Only the one who had found the Grail could sit there and remain. After a first failed meeting with the Fisher King, Percival sat on the Perilous Seat. The stone cracked apart to show that he was unworthy. Percival later repaired it. After he found the Grail, he sat on the Seat once more and joined the stone together.

okr.objective: Describe the Perilous Seat as the Arthurian test that only the Grail finder could pass.
key_results: Name the seat a test that acts like the Celtic Inauguration Stones.
State that only the finder of the Grail could sit in it safely.
Record Percival's failed first sit and his later success.
